RAJYA  SABHA

List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the October 17, 2008/Asvina 25, 1930 (Saka)

(Ministries; Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions  20
1
Dengue deaths
*1.  SHRI BRIJ BHUSHAN TIWARI:
SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that fifteen States
in the country are in the grip of dengue;
(b) if so, the number of persons who
died of dengue and whether Government is
planning to formulate a country-wide plan
to control this disease; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Investment plans of steel companies
*2. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that of late major
steel companies in the country have
announced investment plans;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the tangible progress made therein;
and
(d) the role of Government in
supporting these steel companies in their
investment plans?
Promoting eye donations
*3. SHRIMATI  SUPRIYA SULE: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether eye donations in the
country have increased this year but are
still far from the target of two lakh corneas;
(b) whether to encourage eye donations,
his Ministry has urged Government to
increase one time financial assistance given
to the 500 odd eye banks in the country;
(c) whether during the current year, eye
collection is 32,000 but the need is to collect
at least one lakh eyes every year;
(d) whether his Ministry has also laid
emphasis on Cornea Retrieval Programme;
and
(e) to what extent more aid to eye banks
has helped to boost eye donations?
Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

2
Infant deaths due to clinical trials at
AIIMS
*4. SHRI VIJAY JAWAHARLAL
DARDA:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as many as
49 babies had died at the AIIMS while being
subjected to clinical trials for testing new
drugs and therapies;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government has set up a
special committee to probe reports of the
deaths of children during clinical trials at
the hospital and asked them to submit
report within a week;
(d) if so, the details of the report
submitted by the committee;
(e) whether Government proposes to
review the policy of clinical trials; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Bogibeel Rail-cum-Road Bridge
*5. SHRI SILVIUS CONDPAN: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) what is the present position in the
matter of construction of Bogibeel Rail-
cum-Road Bridge over river Brahmaputra
in Assam under Northern Frontier Railway,
which is a National Project;
(b) whether his Ministry would take-
up the double laning of railway tracks
within Assam upto Tinsukia under
Northern Frontier  Railway to facilitate the
railway users of the seven North-Eastern
States;
(c) whehter the Rangiya Zonal Head
Quarter has started functioning in its full
scale and if not, what are the reasons
therefor; and
(d) what is the present position of
conversion of Lumding-Badarpur route to
broad gauge?
Small caterers and vendors
*6. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA: Will
the Minister of RAILW AYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Catering
Policy of 2005 has virtually removed small
catering and vending contractors whose
holding was confined to one stall and trolley
at A, B, and C stations;
(b) if so, what are the detailed reasons
therefor;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a number
of catering and vending stalls were allotted
to the big companies on all railway stations
after removing the small vending contractors
who were earning their livelihood through
these stalls; and
(d) if so, whether the above action is
not violating the constitutional right of small
contractors?
Subsidized fertilizers to small tea
growers
*7. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of
CHEMICALS AND FERTILIZERS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware about
the scarcity of fertilizers for small tea
growers in Assam;

3
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to mitigate this problem;
(c) whether it is a fact that small tea
growers have to buy fertilizers at higher prices
despite Government's claim that fertilizers
are supplied to farmers at subsidized rates;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps taken by Government to ensure
supply of subsidized fertilizers to small
tea growers; and
(e) whether Government would ensure
the allocation of sufficient quantity of
fertilizers to small tea growers?
